title: Birds and butterfly
story: Three small paintings: a blue songbird among flowers, two parrots on a branch, and a monarch butterfly in a round frame.

title: Kanpur, the city of legacy
story: An illustrated tribute to Kanpur: J.K. Temple, Ganga Ghat, Kanpur Central and the Mill Clock Tower.

title: Nine wildlife panels
story: Koi, butterfly, sparrow, ducks, lion, turtle, deer, red panda and peacock, painted as one square.
